verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Hoppscotch storing collections as plain-text files in a repo for git versioning. The community points the other way: one user notes you can't point workspace data to a specific directory like Bruno does, and an open feature request asks for git-repo sync of collections. Collection import and CLI collection management are adjacent features, not file-based git storage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store collections as plain text files in my repo and version them with git
